steps.en: Officer records a cash or counter payment
steps.id: Officer mencatat pembayaran cash atau counter
steps.why_en: Exists, but the story is removed, so it is counted as partial only.
steps.why_id: Ada, tetapi story sudah dihapus dari scope, jadi hanya dihitung sebagian.

steps.en: The notice is permanently suspended as paid and a receipt is stored
steps.id: Notice disuspend permanen sebagai paid dan receipt disimpan
steps.why_en: Works as described, but the story is removed, so it is counted as partial only.
steps.why_id: Berjalan sesuai, tetapi story sudah dihapus, jadi hanya dihitung sebagian.

steps.en: Officer asks the system to generate a payment slip
steps.id: Officer meminta sistem membuat slip pembayaran
steps.why_en: The staff screen has no such button; the old code for it is switched off in comments.
steps.why_id: Layar staff tidak punya tombol itu; code lamanya dimatikan lewat comment.

steps.en: The slip shows notice, vehicle, amount, date, mode and receipt number
steps.id: Slip memuat notice, kendaraan, jumlah, tanggal, mode, dan nomor receipt
steps.why_en: Only the public portal builds such a receipt, for online payments; no staff slip exists.
steps.why_id: Hanya portal publik yang membuat receipt seperti ini, untuk bayar online; slip staff tidak ada.

steps.en: Officer prints or downloads the slip for the offender
steps.id: Officer mencetak atau mengunduh slip untuk offender
steps.why_en: No print or download for officers; only the offender can download after paying online.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada cetak atau unduh untuk officer; hanya offender yang bisa unduh setelah bayar online.
